F.definition: all parameters trainable, trained on train_F

L.definition: base frozen; LoRA on q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj, gate_proj, up_proj, down_proj of all 28 layers; alpha = 2 * rank; dropout 0; B initialised to 0; A per interpretation B5

A.definition: F plus lambda * KL(p_base || p_theta) on anchor text, 4 anchor documents per step, token-weighted (Pilot section 4; interpretation B6)

tuning: none in E1-V1: each method uses the configuration E1-PILOT selected with the same budget (6 configurations each) and the same DEV-accuracy rule; no damage-based selection (protocol 6.6)

Z0.expectation: parameters bit-identical to N: state_sha256(Z0) == state_sha256(N)

dose.dimension: passes over the 240 TRAIN statements (batch 8, 30 optimizer steps per pass); one run per (method, seed) trained to the largest dose, evaluated in place at every dose point
dose.d0_use: Gate 0 (G0.4, G0.5, G0.8, T1) on F; S and Y are trained to d0
dose.coverage_rationale: protocol 6.3 (Pilot DEV accuracies of F1/F3, L4/L6, A2/A5 at 20 cosine passes, about 11 constant-rate passes)

seeds.use: one curve per (method, seed); data order rng_rule(TRAIN_SEED, 'order:<k>'); LoRA A rng_rule(TRAIN_SEED, 'lora_A:<module path>'); iso points per seed; comparisons on the seed-average and per seed

iso.acquisition: Acc(model, DEV-QA, learned), fact-level mean (Pilot section 5)
iso.bracket: j* = smallest j >= 2 with a_{j-1} < t <= a_j; none -> NOT_REACHED for that seed
iso.tau_dev_rule: t - a_{j*-1} <= 0.10 and a_{j*} - t <= 0.10, otherwise NOT_REACHED for that seed
iso.interpolation: w = (t - a_{j*-1}) / (a_{j*} - a_{j*-1}); per-unit value v_t = (1 - w) * v(lo) + w * v(hi); the same w on TEST
iso.method_rule: a method is comparable at t only if all 3 seeds are bracketed; otherwise NOT_REACHED; no extrapolation
iso.tau_test_rule: |Acq_TEST(X, t) - Acq_TEST(F, t)| > 0.05 (seed-average of interpolated TEST accuracies) -> MATCH_FAILED

checkpoint_retention.rule: after the DEV evaluation of dose point j: save (with state_sha256) if some target t not yet crossed before j has |a_j - t| <= 0.10; never delete
always_saved: S and Y final (3 seeds each)
checkpoint_retention.format: full float32 state_dict for F, A, S, Y, P+, Z0; adapter parameters plus the base state_sha256 for L
checkpoint_retention.disk: about 310 GB expected, 516 GB worst case; rent >= 600 GB (protocol section 12); ST18

training_contract.example_order: one permutation of the corpus per pass from rng_rule(TRAIN_SEED, 'order:<k>'), k = 1..; batches are consecutive slices (interpretation B3)
training_contract.sequence: one statement per sequence followed by <|endoftext|>; pad on the right to the longest sequence in the batch; padding excluded from the loss
training_contract.loss: token-weighted CE over all non-padding target positions (interpretation B4); A adds the anchor KL term of Pilot section 4
training_contract.warmup: linear from 0 over the first 30 steps (pass 1)
training_contract.weight_decay: per method / control config; applied to 2-D weight matrices only, tied embedding included (interpretation B7)
training_contract.precision: bfloat16 autocast with float32 master weights and optimizer state; evaluation float32 without autocast
training_contract.evaluation: DEV evaluation in place after step 30 * k of every dose point, under model.eval() and torch.no_grad(); it changes no parameter, gradient, optimizer state or random stream

same: the same fact tokens at every dose point (k passes over train_F; 3,802 tokens per pass with <|endoftext|>)
different: L trains adapters only (about 34.86M parameters at rank 32); forward parameters base plus adapters
A adds per step the forward of 4 anchor documents through the frozen base and the trained model and the backward of the latter
compute_matching.rationale: acquisition is driven by the fact text read, identical token by token across methods; the extra compute of A and L is part of the method and is reported separately (Pilot section 10, interpretation B18), not converted into fact passes

counts.test_evaluations: N, F@d0 x3, S x3, Y x3 and the bracket checkpoints of the selection freeze record

pending.dose_points_and_configs: protocol section 15 item 3: reduce per section 12 R1-R4 if the estimate exceeds what the Owner accepts
